assumptions: FY2027 is 53 weeks ending 2027-01-31. GAAP diluted EPS assumptions: bear $8.50, base $10.00, bull $11.00. They begin with reported GAAP H1 EPS of $4.85 (six months ended 2026-07-26) and therefore imply residual H2 EPS of $3.65/$5.15/$6.15, respectively, using a constant-share approximation across reported interim and assumed annual EPS. Q3 revenue outlook is $108bn +/-2%, with no China Data Center compute revenue assumed; Q4 is a 14-week quarter. Bear tests weaker AI infrastructure conversion or margins below outlook; base assumes Q3 demand conversion and a profitable 14-week Q4; bull assumes stronger conversion/shipments and sustained margins. P/E values 20x/23x/26x are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not observed multiples, consensus, fair values, or probabilities.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
